title: lichen-gateway tunnel_auth revocation test fails: accept_post returns Revoked where test demands Replay
description: Pre-existing deterministic failure on HEAD, discovered during w0fp verification. cargo test -p lichen-gateway --lib: tunnel_auth::tests::revocation_root_change_expiry_and_lru_fail_closed panics at lichen-gateway/src/tunnel_auth.rs:954: after table.revoke(second_claim.prefix, len, route_hash, path_seq), re-submitting the same signed POST (accept_post(second.body..., own, 3)) returns Err(TunnelAuthError::Revoked) but the test asserts Err(TunnelAuthError::Replay). File has a single commit (660b9bf3bf feat: link layer security, SCHC rules 5-6, gateway tunnel auth) and the tree is clean, so the test was committed failing or an ordering change (revocation check before replay check in accept_post) landed without the test update. Decide the normative ordering: a revoked-but-replayed POST should presumably still count as replay evidence for the sender's sequence floor, or revocation should dominate; fix accept_post or the test with an explicit rationale (never weaken the assertion without a security argument). Gate: cargo test -p lichen-gateway must be green.
